sampling.malware: 10 distinct package names per available discovery year, ranked by SHA256(seed:path), compressed archive512..524288bytes; three fixed smoke packages retained
sampling.benign: 20 explicitly pinned pure-Python official wheels plus four real project baselines
limitations: One malware vendor/source; original selection bias persists.
Small-archive and language filters exclude large/binary-only malware.
Unknown malware families prevent family-disjoint evaluation claims.
Benign reputation labels are not proof of benignness.
Temporal partitions are per observation date; discovery/upload/commit clocks differ.
